WITH code_laps AS (
  SELECT positionText, 
         SUM(CAST(laps AS INTEGER)) as lap_sum
  FROM results
  WHERE positionText IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY positionText
),
total_laps AS (
  SELECT SUM(lap_sum) as total_lap_sum
  FROM code_laps
),
divisions AS (
  SELECT code_laps.positionText,
         code_laps.lap_sum,
         CAST(code_laps.lap_sum AS REAL) / total_laps.total_lap_sum as division
  FROM code_laps
  CROSS JOIN total_laps
  WHERE total_laps.total_lap_sum IS NOT NULL
),
avg_division AS (
  SELECT AVG(division) as avg_div
  FROM divisions
),
filtered_divisions AS (
  SELECT divisions.positionText,
         divisions.lap_sum,
         divisions.division,
         divisions.division - avg_division.avg_div as difference
  FROM divisions
  CROSS JOIN avg_division
  WHERE avg_division.avg_div IS NOT NULL
    AND divisions.division > avg_division.avg_div
)
SELECT SUM(lap_sum) as total_lap_sums,
       AVG(division) as avg_divisions,
       AVG(difference) as avg_differences
FROM filtered_divisions
